mapper.select: select ipmb.*, smb.material_batch_no, smb.original_batch_no, smb.expired_date, smb.hydration, smb.no_hydration_content, smb.producer, smb.supplier, smb.report_no, smb.licence_no, smb.factory_batch_no, smb.original_batch_no from bm_ingredient_plan_material_batch ipmb left join bm_storage_material_batch smb on ipmb.material_batch_id = smb.id where ipmb.is_deleted = 0 and ipmb.ingredient_plan_id = #{ingredientPlanId} and ipmb.formula_material_id = #{formulaMaterialId} order by smb.material_batch_no

select ipmb.*, smb.material_batch_no, smb.original_batch_no, smb.expired_date, smb.hydration, smb.no_hydration_content, smb.producer, smb.supplier, smb.report_no, smb.licence_no, smb.factory_batch_no, smb.original_batch_no from bm_ingredient_plan_material_batch ipmb left join bm_storage_material_batch smb on ipmb.material_batch_id = smb.id where ipmb.is_deleted = 0 and ipmb.ingredient_plan_id = #{ingredientPlanId}
